Why so bad? You buy a bond for its yield. Ten years ago, the long Treasury paid 2%. That was the ceiling, and then rates rose (price losses), taking even that away.

Some perspective: in 223 years, a negative 10-year return has happened in 25 months. 24 of them are right now. The only other was Dec 1959, at -0.08%.
